name: diagram_tool
description: Generate diagrams (flowcharts, architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams) from Graphviz DOT language code. Outputs PNG or SVG files.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Graphviz DOT language code describing the diagram. Supports digraph/graph, rankdir, shapes (box/diamond/ellipse/record/note), subgraph cluster_*, labels, style/fillcolor/color.
